note: Wikimedia Commons, “Loza Nemanjica Decani e 5.jpg”; artist as recorded there: XIV century Serbian painter — fetched 03 October 2026 at 1200px. The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Commons describes it «Detail of fresco Loza Nemanjića, Sava II (Predislav), Visoki Dečani, Serbia», dates the painting 1346/1347 and categorises it under 'Saint Sava II' — a portrait of this archbishop in the Nemanjić family tree at Dečani, named by both his archiepiscopal and his baptismal name, which is what separates him from Sava I. Taken in preference to the burial fresco at Peć, which shows the funeral and not the man. Commons describes it: Detail of fresco Loza Nemanjića, Sava II (Predislav), Visoki Dečani, Serbia.
